source_or_prompt.exact_prompt: Create a single cinematic editorial photograph-style AI concept image for a Korean real-estate documentary about the everyday routine of a family after moving into a developing residential area. Entirely fictional, not a real Namyangju or Wangsuk street or school. Wide 16:9 landscape, eye-level candid documentary composition. A Korean parent walking hand-in-hand with a primary-school-age child wearing a simple backpack along an ordinary tree-lined pedestrian path beside believable apartment buildings. Quiet morning, warm natural daylight, contemporary modest clothing, realistic human proportions and ordinary residential landscaping, not luxury-advertising perfection. A small neighborhood park and people at a distance add depth, building façades stay non-identifiable. Rich foreground/midground/background layers suitable for a gentle cinematic camera move. No recognizable city landmarks, no school logos or named schools, no text, no readable signage, no infographic, no collage. This illustrates a family's needs, not evidence that any planned school or facility has opened. Keep the lower strip calm for editor-added captions. The editor will add a persistent AI concept label; do not generate typography.
